question:
Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) ridiculous pyramidal big leather sock
(B) ridiculous big pyramidal leather sock

segments.text: We need to determine correct adjective order in English.
The order: opinion, size, shape, age, color, origin, material, purpose, noun.
Actually typical order: opinion, size, shape, age, color, origin, material, purpose, noun.
Here adjectives: ridiculous (opinion), big (size), pyramidal (shape), leather (material).
So correct order: opinion (ridiculous) then size (big) then shape (pyramidal) then material (leather) then noun (sock).
So order: ridiculous big pyramidal leather sock.
Option B matches that: "ridiculous big pyramidal leather sock".
Option A: ridiculous pyramidal big leather sock (opinion, shape, size, material) wrong.
